TASK-1945 S3a is ready for review: PR #2846 (https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2846), branch claude/task-1945-s3, head c278fa3342.

- Contains: items a, b, c and f; tests 1–13 and 16–19; C2 (TASK-2150 and TASK-2151); C3 (the forbidden-token test covers the new files); C4 (the wake never names --override).
- C1: the shared forge_commit_ci.rs reader, with your 08:50 condition met (aggregator_const_matches_the_ci_workflow parses ci.yml). Per impl-story-1689, a skipped or neutral required check is NOT success.
- Merge note: origin/main's STORY-1887 ShipBatchStep conflicted on the event kind lists. I kept both, and the monitor contract is now 1.9.0.
- Local gates: check-ci-fast, test-touched and check-ci-compile pass after the merge.
- This is gate code (the pr_cmd approval_decision and merge_hold corpus_gate_decision extractions), so the operator ships it. I won't ship, merge or approve it.

S3b (items d and e, tests 14–15, "(TASK-1945)") starts after this merges.
subject: TASK-1945 S3a ready: PR #2846
